title: A copper wall releasing heat, held at 300 K on both faces
shows: 10 MW/m³ released evenly in a 40 mm copper wall whose faces are held at 300 K: in the steady state the temperature is a parabola, q·L²/(8k) = 5.26 K above the faces in the middle and q·L²/(12k) = 3.51 K above them on average.
source: Plane wall with uniform generation: T. L. Bergman, A. S. Lavine, F. P. Incropera and D. P. DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 7th ed. (2011), §3.5.
